title.original: Identifying and Mitigating Systemic Measurement Bias in Production LLM Inference Benchmarks
title.zh: 识别和减轻生产LLM推理基准中的系统测量偏差
title.en: Identifying and Mitigating Systemic Measurement Bias in Production LLM Inference Benchmarks

inclusion_reason.zh: 该多进程压测框架、客户端排队模型和 NTPOT 指标共同修正生产 LLM 基准的系统性测量偏差。
inclusion_reason.en: The multi-process load harness, client queue model, and NTPOT metric jointly correct systemic measurement bias in production LLM benchmarks.

abstract.zh: 该工作指出常见单进程 asyncio 压测客户端在高并发下形成客户端排队，系统性夸大服务端 TTFT 与 TPOT。作者用 M/G/1 模型解释 GIL 瓶颈，并提出多进程无偏评测框架与归一化 TPOT 指标。
abstract.en: This work shows that common single-process asyncio benchmark clients queue locally at high concurrency and systematically inflate server TTFT and TPOT. It models the GIL bottleneck as an M/G/1 queue, then proposes a multi-process harness and Normalized TPOT metric.

problem.zh: 生产吞吐测试常把客户端 CPU/GIL 排队计入服务器响应时间，负载越高偏差越严重，导致 SLO 容量判断和引擎比较失真。
problem.en: Production load tests often include client CPU/GIL queueing in server latency, with bias worsening at higher request rates and distorting SLO capacity and engine comparisons.

approach.zh: 作者先用排队论推导单进程客户端偏差，再把请求发生器拆为多进程分摊负载；NTPOT 则跨序列长度摊销预填充、调度和端到端时延。
approach.en: The authors derive single-process bias with queueing theory, distribute request generation across processes, and use NTPOT to amortize prefill, scheduling, and end-to-end latency across sequence lengths.

system_design.zh: 评测控制器在多个独立进程中产生并计时请求，监测并约束客户端排队开销，再汇总 TTFT、TPOT 与 NTPOT，使报告更接近纯服务引擎行为。
system_design.en: A controller generates and timestamps traffic in independent processes, monitors client-side queue overhead, and aggregates TTFT, TPOT, and NTPOT to isolate serving-engine behavior.

key_results.zh: 实证结果表明多进程方法能把客户端排队降到可忽略水平，并在每秒数千请求的生产规模下得到更准确、可复现的引擎画像。
key_results.en: Empirical results report negligible client queueing with the multi-process method and more accurate, reproducible engine profiles at production loads of thousands of queries per second.

limitations.zh: 方法主要修正 Python 客户端侧偏差，不能消除网络抖动、服务器计时误差或负载模型不真实；多进程发生器本身也需要足够独立 CPU 与时钟校准。
limitations.en: The method corrects a Python client-side bias but not network jitter, server instrumentation error, or unrealistic traffic models; the multi-process generator also needs sufficient isolated CPU and clock calibration.

workloads: production LLM inference load tests exceeding thousands of queries per second

notes.zh: 千级 QPS、单进程基线、多进程框架和指标集合来自官方摘要；服务模型、客户端 CPU、进程数和逐点偏差待全文审计。
notes.en: Thousand-plus QPS, the single-process baseline, multi-process harness, and metric set come from the official abstract; served models, client CPU, process counts, and pointwise bias await full-text audit.
